overview: This enum selects which pain voice a fighter or shikigami plays when a hit lands.

None.simple: This leaves the hit with no normal pain voice.
None.technical: EGameCharacterDamageVoiceType::None is the constructor default for FGameDataTableRow_Damage::DamageVoiceType. ActionController_PlayDamageVoice returns before requesting a voice when this value reaches it. FGameCharacterAction_BlowSpin promotes it to Blow when the damage row is used by a spin hit.

Weak.simple: This picks a light pain voice.
Weak.technical: ActionController_PlayDamageVoice sends this enumerator as voice id 6 with Value 1. UGameCharacterActionController::PlayVoice and UGameShikigamiActionController::PlayVoice reject values at or below zero and read Id_VoiceGroup[Value - 1], so this selects the first damage voice slot. FGameCharacterAction_BlowSpin promotes it to Blow.

Medium.simple: This picks a medium pain voice.
Medium.technical: ActionController_PlayDamageVoice sends this enumerator as voice id 6 with Value 2. The character and shikigami damage voice paths read Id_VoiceGroup[Value - 1], so this selects the second damage voice slot. FGameCharacterAction_BlowSpin promotes it to Blow.

Heavy.simple: This picks a heavy pain voice.
Heavy.technical: ActionController_PlayDamageVoice sends this enumerator as voice id 6 with Value 3. The character and shikigami damage voice paths read Id_VoiceGroup[Value - 1], so this selects the third damage voice slot. FGameCharacterAction_BlowSpin passes values above Medium through unchanged.

LargeHeavy.simple: This picks a very heavy pain voice.
LargeHeavy.technical: ActionController_PlayDamageVoice sends this enumerator as voice id 6 with Value 4. The character and shikigami damage voice paths read Id_VoiceGroup[Value - 1], so this selects the fourth damage voice slot. FGameCharacterAction_BlowSpin passes it through unchanged.

Blow.simple: This picks the pain voice used for blows.
Blow.technical: ActionController_PlayDamageVoice sends this enumerator as voice id 6 with Value 5. The character and shikigami damage voice paths read Id_VoiceGroup[Value - 1], so this selects the fifth damage voice slot. FGameCharacterAction_BlowSpin promotes None, Weak, and Medium to this value before the voice request.

Invalid.simple: This is an undefined pain voice setting.
Invalid.technical: EGameCharacterDamageVoiceType::Invalid is declared after Blow. No explicit case or exported damage row for this value was found. A raw value of this size would pass PlayVoice's Index <= 0 check and then be used as Id_VoiceGroup[Index - 1] without an upper bounds check, so the result cannot be treated as a defined voice slot.

notes: The value is stored in FGameDataTableRow_Damage::DamageVoiceType and defaults to None in the row constructor.
The normal damage voice request uses id 6. A set SpecialDamageVoiceType uses id 7 while the owner's DamageVoiceTimer is not positive, which replaces the normal id 6 request.
Character and shikigami voice paths both convert the enumerator to Value and index a damage voice group at Value - 1 after rejecting nonpositive values.
FGameCharacterAction_BlowSpin changes None, Weak, and Medium to Blow for its damage rows. FGameCharacterAction_BlowGroundRestraint and ordinary damage reactions pass the row value through.
